frustration_score.description: Customer frustration or hesitation level from 1 (calm) to 10 (about to leave).

main_objection.description: Main reason the customer is hesitant to buy, as a short phrase in the customer's language.

next_best_action.description: Direct recommendation for the Sales Agent's next message.

summary.description: Dense 3-line summary of the customer's key requests, separated by newlines.
